verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt at docs.extend.ai/llms.txt (HTTP 200) describing the platform. The docs are also served as raw markdown pages (.md URLs) and include an Agent Quickstart, so an agent can be pointed directly at agent-oriented docs. Missing for 10: evidence of the llms.txt's completeness or depth (e.g., an llms-full.txt variant), and independent or hands-on corroboration of agents successfully consuming these docs.
